original_high_level_goal.name: Facilitate Rapid Genetic Variant Annotation
original_high_level_goal.description: Enable researchers to quickly annotate and interpret genetic variants to support their studies, including converting DNA changes into protein changes.

actor.name: Researchers
actor.description: Individuals conducting studies on genetic variants and their implications.

original_high_level_goal.name: Enhance Clinical Decision-Making
original_high_level_goal.description: Provide clinicians with comprehensive insights into genetic data, including data on mutation frequencies and clinical actionability, to improve patient care and treatment decisions.

actor.name: Clinicians
actor.description: Medical professionals who interpret genetic data to inform patient care.

branch_002.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate informed clinical decision-making by providing clinicians with essential genetic variant information.
branch_002.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly states that the tool provides clinicians with data on mutation frequencies and clinical actionability to facilitate understanding of genetic variants. This directly supports the parent HLG's focus on enhancing clinical decision-making and the reconstructed HLG's focus on facilitating informed decisions through essential information. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core intention by maintaining the clinician actor and the objective of supporting decision-making through genetic data. Although it generalizes 'comprehensive insights' to 'essential information', the fundamental WHY-level goal remains aligned with the parent.

original_high_level_goal.name: Streamline High-Throughput Bioinformatics Analysis
original_high_level_goal.description: Allow bioinformaticians to efficiently conduct high-throughput analysis of genetic information, including predicting functional impacts of protein mutations and accessing data on gene functions and variant effects.

actor.name: Bioinformaticians
actor.description: Specialists who analyze and interpret biological data, particularly genetic information.

branch_003.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate comprehensive analysis and interpretation of genetic data for bioinformaticians.
branch_003.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly supports the parent HLG by mentioning the facilitation of high-throughput analysis and access to data on gene functions and variant effects. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it accurately summarizes the tool's purpose of comprehensive annotation and interpretation for the specified user group. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention by maintaining the same actor (bioinformaticians) and objective (analyzing/interpreting genetic data), effectively summarizing the parent's specific high-throughput and variant-effect details into a broader but semantically equivalent goal.
